ei.title: The Hidden Labor in a Computerized Era
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: The promise of a computerized society, we were told, was that it would pass to machines all of the repetitive drudgery of work, allowing us humans to pursue higher purposes and to have more leisure time. It didn't work out this way. Instead of more time, most of us have less. Companies large and small have off-loaded work onto the backs of consumers. Things that used to be done for us, as part of the value-added service of working with a company, we are now expected to do ourselves. With air travel, we're now expected to complete our own reservations and check-in, jobs that used to be done by airline employees or travel agents. At the grocery store, we're expected to bag our own groceries and, in some supermarkets, to scan our own purchases.

det.tip: 동사 → 현재분사(-ing) 분사구문: allow → allowing

questions.passage: The promise of a computerized society, we were told, was that it would pass to machines all of the repetitive drudgery of work, allowing us humans to pursue higher purposes and to have more leisure time. It didn't work out this way. Instead of more time, most of us have less. Companies large and small have off-loaded work onto the backs of consumers. Things that used to be done for us, as part of the value-added service of working with a company, we are now expected to do ourselves. With air travel, we're now expected to complete our own reservations and check-in, jobs that used to be done by airline employees or travel agents. At the grocery store, we're expected to bag our own groceries and, in some supermarkets, to scan our own purchases.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ 소비자에게 떠넘겨진 노동
det.analysis:
❌ ① 예약 방법: 세부 예시일 뿐 주제 아님
❌ ② 기계가 인간 대체: 본문은 오히려 사람이 더 일한다고 함
✅ ③ 소비자에게 떠넘긴 노동: 컴퓨터화가 여가를 주기는커녕 회사 일을 소비자에게 떠넘겼다는 글의 핵심 ← 정답
❌ ④ 셀프 계산대의 이점: 예시일 뿐, 이점이 주제 아님
det.tip: promise(여가) ↔ reality(소비자 노동 증가)

det.tip: off-loaded work onto consumers = 소비자 노동 증가

ch: 컴퓨터화는 약속대로 인간에게 더 많은 여가를 주었다.

소비자는 셀프 서비스를 통해 더 많은 혜택을 누린다.
